note: Bookshelf order + business-model data (docs/APP_UI_PLAN.md). A tale appears only when res://stories/<id>/story.tscn and script.json exist (so wolf_goats / patjuk show up by themselves when their agents land them); a story dir not listed here is appended at the end. Fields: free (open without '모든 동화 열기'), kind classic|original (original = creative tale with the child's name; name_slots = the name slots its lines use), hidden (true = keep it off the shelf while it is being built). Tale agents may add or edit their own entry.
